# Harrow Point Ferry: service

Harrow Point Ferry Co. runs a passenger ferry between Harrow Point and Gull Island. A crossing takes 40 minutes.

In summer (June to August) boats leave Harrow Point at 7:00, 9:30, 12:00, 15:00 and 18:30. In winter there are three sailings a day, at 8:00, 12:00 and 16:00.

The ferry carries up to 180 passengers and 12 bicycles. Cars are not carried.
